recipes.title: Chicken Crunch Wrap
instructions: Yogurt sauce- Add garlic, salt and pepper to Greek yogurt
Season cut chicken piece with salt garlic, onion, paprika, oregano, cumin, Chilli flakes
Cook chicken for 5-6 mins in a pan until done with some oil.
Assemble wrap with tortilla and toast on pan till brown.

recipes.title: Burrito Bowl
instructions: Cut and prep veggies- onion, bell pepper
Cut Chicken and season with oil, garlic power, onion powder, Paprika, cumin powder, oregano, add pepper and salt.
Salsa - corn, tomato, onion, lime, salt/pepper.
Make cilantro lime rice with butter, salt and pepper.
Plate the dish with Cheese garnish.

recipes.title: Sambaar
instructions: Saute mustard seeds, onion, tomato, Veggies and garlic for 5 mins.
Add toor daal and pressure cook for 3 Whistles with Salt
After cooker cools; Add water, sambaar powder, chilli powder and boil
Adjust salt and spice and serve with Hot Rice
